newsHighlights.title: Translation earbuds break language barriers for tai chi learners
newsHighlights.summary: AI-powered translation earbuds are helping overseas tai chi learners overcome language barriers and follow Chinese martial arts instruction with ease.
newsHighlights.translation: 人工智能翻译耳机正帮助海外太极拳学习者克服语言障碍，轻松跟随中国武术教学。

newsHighlights.title: Airborne wind power system aces trial

newsHighlights.translation: 中国的高空风力发电系统成功完成试验，在追求更清洁、更灵活的可再生能源方面实现了技术突破。

newsHighlights.title: A new chapter begins: Giant pandas return to Zoo Atlanta

newsHighlights.title: Nation's role in world auto sector on show

newsHighlights.translation: 国际汽车制造商正把中国不仅作为主要市场，也作为研发车辆、技术和培养人才的基地。

quote.quote: If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head. If you talk to him in his language, that goes to his heart.
quote.author: Nelson Mandela
quote.translation: 如果你用一个人听得懂的语言与他交谈，他会记在脑中；如果你用他的母语与他交谈，他会记在心里。
quote.explanation: 这句名言强调语言是通往理解与情感的桥梁。今日新闻中翻译耳机帮助海外太极拳学习者跨越语言障碍，正是让文化真正走进人心的体现——真正的学习不止于知识的传递，更在于心灵的共鸣。

pattern.pattern: enable somebody to do something（使某人能够做某事）
pattern.example: The translation earbuds enable overseas learners to follow tai chi instruction in real time.
pattern.translation: 翻译耳机使海外学习者能够实时跟随太极拳指导。
pattern.usage: enable 后接宾语，再接 to do 不定式作宾语补足语，表示赋予某人能力或条件。比 can 更正式，常用于说明文与新闻报道。同义结构还有 allow/permit somebody to do something、make it possible for somebody to do something。

grammar.title: 现在分词短语作伴随状语与结果状语
grammar.explanation: 在新闻英语中，动词的 -ing 形式常放在句中或句末，表示与主句动作同时发生的伴随情况，或自然而然的结果，逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。这种结构能让句子更紧凑、信息密度更高，是新闻写作的高频句式。
examples: International automakers are using China not only as a major market but as a base for developing vehicles, technologies and talent.
Smart earbuds are helping learners overcome language barriers, opening a new chapter in cross-cultural education.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 /breɪk/。难点在于 /kθr/ 三个辅音连缀：先发 /k/，舌尖迅速伸出轻咬发清辅音 /θ/，随即收回落到 /r/。注意 /θ/ 不要发成 /s/ 或 /t/，/r/ 是卷舌音，舌尖不触碰上颚。可先慢读 break-through，再连读加速。
examples: The trial of the airborne wind power system is a real breakthrough.
Translation technology has made a major breakthrough in language learning.

reading.title: Breaking Language Barriers with Smart Earbuds
reading.content:
For many overseas tai chi learners, the hardest part of mastering the slow, graceful movements has never been the movements themselves. It has been the language. Terms such as qigong and dantian can leave beginners confused, and few schools can offer bilingual instructors.

That is changing. With AI-powered translation earbuds, learners now hear clear instructions in their own language while practicing, making classes more immersive and far less frustrating. Teachers say the technology does not replace human guidance. Instead, it helps students focus on posture, breathing and patience.

The story is a small example of a bigger trend. From renewable energy trials to wildlife conservation programs, technology and openness are turning cultural differences into shared learning. Tools change quickly, but the spirit of practice — curiosity, perseverance and respect — remains the same.
reading.translation:
对许多海外太极拳学习者来说，掌握这套缓慢而优美的动作最难的部分从来不是动作本身，而是语言。诸如“气功”“丹田”这样的术语常让初学者一头雾水，而能提供双语教学的学校寥寥无几。

如今情况正在改变。借助人工智能翻译耳机，学习者练习时能听到母语的清晰指导，课程更具沉浸感，也不再那么令人沮丧。老师们说，这项技术并不能取代人的指导，恰恰相反，它帮助学员把注意力放在姿势、呼吸与耐心上。

这个故事只是一个更大趋势的缩影。从可再生能源试验到野生动物保护项目，技术与开放正在把文化差异转化为共同的学习。工具更新换代很快，但练习的精神——好奇心、毅力与尊重——始终不变。
reading.sourceNote: 改编自 China Daily 2026年11月10日报道《Translation earbuds break language barriers for tai chi learners》，并结合当日《Airborne wind power system aces trial》与《A new chapter begins: Giant pandas return to Zoo Atlanta》两篇报道改写。
